📍 How to Find It & Parking
A quick tip for first-timers: finding the location can be a little tricky if you're relying strictly on Google photos. The space is simple, warm, and inviting. The walls are painted a vibrant yellow and decorated with lovely Madurai street-style artwork, setting a cozy and nostalgic tone the moment you walk in.

🍽️ The Food (Breakfast & Takeaway)
Every single dish was cooked to perfection by the main chef (the owner’s wife), making us feel like we were right back in our hometown.

Plain Dosa: Perfectly roasted, deliciously crispy with a subtle tang. It came with an ample serving of well-balanced sambar and two incredible chutneys—a silky, tangy tomato chutney and a super fresh coconut chutney.

Pepper Chicken Semi-Gravy & Chicken Gravy: The Pepper Chicken semi-gravy is an absolute must-try—the chicken was melt-in-your-mouth tender with a rich, perfectly spiced masala. The chicken gravy was subtle, full of flavor, and so satisfying that I polished off the whole bowl with my dosa.

Onion Uthappam & Medu Vada: The uthappam was golden brown and evenly cooked on both sides with sweet, cooked onions throughout. The Medu Vada (portion of two) was spot-on—crispy on the outside, light and soft on the inside.

Egg Omelette: Made generously with fresh onions and coriander.

Mutton Chukka (Takeaway): Mind-blowing flavor. The mutton pieces were bite-sized, tender, and incredibly juicy.

Filter Coffee: Pure, authentic South Indian filter coffee. The perfect finish to a heavy brekkie!

🤝 Service & Hosting
We were welcomed with genuine warmth by the owner, Naveen. A Project Manager by profession and a passionate foodie from a restaurant family, his hospitality is top-tier. He took the time to make us comfortable, chat with us, and make sure we had everything we needed.
